== Biography ==
=== 2019 Season ===
Lê '''Glory''' Ngọc Vinh joined Maximal as a Support player, despite after a disappointing 2-0 lost in the first series of [[VCS B/2019 Season/Spring Round II|VCS B Round II]] Glory performed well enough to earn a move to the struggling [[Cherry Esports]] as a mid laner for the [[VCS/2019 Season/Summer Promotion]], despite carrying game 3 and 4 '''Glory''' could not complete the reverse sweep as [[FTV Esports]] won 3-2, due to this defeat '''Glory''' returned to [[Maximal]]. 

However '''Glory''' joined [[Percent Esports]] before the [[VCS B/2019 Season/Winter Round I|VCB Winter]]. This time as a jungler until the third round, where he returned to mid lane to face his former team [[Maximal]] where the team would lose 2-0 in the quarterfinal.

=== 2020 Spring ===
'''Glory''' almost lost his chance to qualify during the [[VCS_B/2020_Season/Summer_Season|VCS B]] group stages after losing to [[Leonard (Vietnamese Team)|Leonard]], the team bottom of their group. However his team rallied to qualify 1st from Group A before defeating [[QTV Gaming]] 2-1 and [[Puppies Esports]] (the academy team of [[CERBERUS Esports (Vietnamese Team)|CERBERUS Esports]]) 2-1. 

In the [[VCS B/2020 Season|VCS B]] after being defeated 3-1 by [[OverPower Esports]] '''Percent Esports''' defeated [[QTV Gaming]] 3-0 and [[FTV Esports]] 3-2 to secure a place in the [[VCS/2020 Season/Summer Season|VCS 2020 Summer Season]].

In the [[2020 Pulsefire Cup]] [[Percent Esports]] were overwhelmed by VCS teams, however at an individual level '''Glory''' showed talent despite losing all three games with an average KDA of 5.66/3/3.

== Trivia ==
* Is a big fan of K-Pop group ''BLACKPINK'', together with [[Shine (Tôn Nguyễn Phi Long)|Shine]] and [[Lisa (Phạm Thạch Nhân Băng)|Lisa]].<ref>[https://vcsenglish.wordpress.com/2020/05/22/meet-percent-esports/ Meet Percent Esports, the newest member of VCS!] ''vcsenglish.wordpress.com''</ref>
*He was awarded the title of National Esports Grandmaster by VIRESA (Vietnam Esports Federation) after achieving good results with [[Team Whales]] at [[2023_Season_World_Championship|Worlds 2023]] and with [[Vietnam (National Team)|Vietnam National Team]] at [[2022 Asian Games]] on January 21, 2024.
